title: AI model API prices
question: What do the leading AI models cost through their APIs, per million tokens?
scope: Flagship models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, Mistral and DeepSeek, at each provider's standard rate for ordinary prompts, without batch, caching, fast-mode or long-context changes. Some providers charge more for very long prompts, and that isn't shown here. Where a provider has announced a new price, it gets its own row. Values come only from each provider's own pages. Not a complete list of models.

columns.label: Input
columns.rule: The standard price for input tokens. Where the provider charges by time of day, the peak price.

columns.label: Output
columns.rule: The standard price for output tokens. Where the provider charges by time of day, the peak price.
